problems.device: proton exchange membrane fuel cell stack
problems.failure: membrane dehydration under high current density raises ionic resistance and localizes hot spots, degrading power output even when coolant temperature is nominal
problems.constraint: maintain 1.5 A/cm2 current density at 80 C stack temperature without increasing cathode humidification parasitic load above 10 percent

problems.failure: positive grid corrosion during extended float charge consumes grid cross-section, raising internal resistance until capacity falls below service threshold
problems.constraint: achieve 15-year float service life at 2.27 V per cell continuous charge without antimony content above 2 percent

problems.device: stainless steel plate heat exchanger in a district cooling loop
problems.failure: biofilm and scale accumulation on plate channels reduces overall heat transfer coefficient and raises pressure drop between cleanings
problems.constraint: sustain heat transfer coefficient above 2500 W/m2K for 12 months between mechanical cleanings without chlorination above 0.5 ppm residual

problems.failure: cavitation bubble collapse near impeller vane leading edges erodes material and degrades head delivery at off-design flow
problems.constraint: operate at 85 percent of best-efficiency flow while keeping NPSH margin above 1.5 m and vane life above 5 years

problems.failure: creep and ozone-induced cracking of elastomer layers accumulate permanent deformation and stiffness drift over decades of traffic cycling
problems.constraint: hold vertical deflection drift below 10 percent of design over a 75-year service life with no replacement access after installation

problems.failure: biofilm regrowth in dead-end mains consumes disinfectant residual and drives nitrification episodes raising nitrite above the regulatory limit
problems.constraint: maintain total chlorine residual above 1.0 mg/L at the farthest customer during 25 C summer demand without boosting disinfectant dose

problems.device: wearable continuous glucose monitor electrochemical sensor
problems.failure: protein and tissue encapsulation at the sensor working electrode attenuates glucose signal within days of wear, drifting readings outside the MARD limit
problems.constraint: keep mean absolute relative difference below 10 percent over a 14-day wear without daily recalibration

problems.failure: shock-induced contact between comb fingers causes stiction that permanently shorts interdigitated electrodes and latches the proof mass
problems.constraint: survive 10000 g mechanical shock in all axes without permanent zero-g offset above 50 mg

problems.failure: moisture and oxygen barrier properties of the ethylene-vinyl alcohol layer degrade during distribution as humidity plasticizes the polymer matrix
problems.constraint: hold water vapor transmission rate below 0.5 g/m2/day over 18 months of shelf life at 25 C and 65 percent relative humidity

problems.device: crystalline silicon photovoltaic module in a high-voltage string
problems.failure: potential-induced degradation as sodium ions migrate from cover glass into cell shunting paths under sustained system voltage bias
problems.constraint: limit annual power loss below 0.5 percent over 25 years at 1000 V system bias without encapsulant replacement

problems.failure: internal bearing heat generation thermally elongates the spindle shaft, shifting the tool center point and widening part tolerance during warmup cycles
problems.constraint: hold tool center point displacement below 10 micrometers across the full 20-minute warmup transient without adding warmup idle cycles

problems.device: submerged hollow-fiber membrane bioreactor for municipal wastewater
problems.failure: soluble microbial product and extracellular polymeric substance layers consolidate on membrane fibers, collapsing permeability and forcing intense chemical cleaning
problems.constraint: sustain net flux above 18 LMH with chemical cleaning intervals longer than 6 months at mixed liquor suspended solids of 8 g/L

metrics.identical_instrument_rule: Every metric below is computed by the SAME code path on BOTH arms (baseline worktree 7dbebe94 and R401 HEAD) from the SAME artifact shapes. Instruments that are structurally impossible on an arm (the baseline produces no structured mechanism space) are reported as NOT_COMPUTABLE_ON_BASELINE (NCB) — never as zero, never silently dropped (Art. XXV).

per_problem.n_candidates_generated: count of candidate records produced by the arm's own generation stages (baseline: EXPLORATION_GRID candidates + primary SYNTHESIZE mechanism; R401: mechanism-space candidates in envelope_MECHANISM_SPACE.json)
per_problem.n_materially_distinct: the R401 structural comparator (mechanism_space.deduplicate_candidates) applied to the arm's own candidate records — same instrument, both arms
per_problem.testable_prediction_rate: fraction of candidates whose testable-prediction field passes mechanism_space._testable_prediction_check — same instrument, both arms
per_problem.evidence_support_rate: from the arm's own envelope_VERIFY.json evidence_classification counts: (DIRECT_SUPPORT + PARTIAL_SUPPORT) / n_items
per_problem.contradiction_rate: CONTRADICTORY / n_items from the same envelope
per_problem.final_status: the run's own final_state.json final_status (honest vocabulary: REJECTED is an acceptable result)
per_problem.cad_rate: fraction of candidates reaching an INVENTION_SPECIFICATION artifact
per_problem.physics_beats_baseline: count of stage_PHYSICS.json records with lifecycle BEATS_BASELINE
per_problem.attack_survival: count of candidates whose ENGINEERING_ATTACK overall != KILLED

headline.name: MD-EST per problem (materially distinct, evidence-supported, technically testable mechanisms on a previously unseen problem)
headline.definition: per problem, the count of mechanisms that satisfy ALL THREE: (a) materially distinct — kept by the common structural comparator; (b) technically testable — passes the common testable-prediction check; (c) evidence-supported — the arm's own VERIFY-stage evidence classification shows DIRECT_SUPPORT + PARTIAL_SUPPORT above zero for the run (the run-level evidence condition is computable identically on both arms; the R401 arm ADDITIONALLY reports per-candidate mechanism-level SUPPORTS as a capability column, marked NCB for the baseline).
headline.benchmark_score: fraction of the 12 problems with MD-EST >= 3, plus the mean MD-EST count; both reported per arm with the delta.
headline.rule: the headline is computed by the same code on both arms; a rejection-heavy result is honest; a fabricated winner is not.

protocol.baseline_arm: detached git worktree at 7dbebe940fe73f47a420b4f0ca2f9e5188d22ca4 (the pre-R401 production engine; byte-identical to the deployed artifact, proven R401-WC); .env.keys copied for retrieval; ENGINE_*_PROVIDER=zai pins (the documented degraded-endpoint mechanism, recorded in the per-call ledger)
protocol.r401_arm: the HEAD engine (mechanism_space 16-stage chain) in the main checkout at the measurement commit (recorded in the run record)
protocol.llm_transport: zai local gateway (scripts/zai_gateway.mjs) with the in-process lifecycle; every call logged with hashes; quota exhaustion is an honest BLOCKED state (Art. XXV), never a quality result
protocol.retrieval: live, both arms, identical lanes (EuropePMC primary + the engine's own multi-source expansion); rate limits are recorded states, never absence
protocol.order: problems are run in the frozen list order, one at a time, per arm; each problem is resumable (the EngineRun conductor's own resume path); an interrupted battery continues without re-burning completed problems
protocol.fidelity_guard: before the battery, the frozen benchmark file hash is verified (the battery refuses to run against a mutated benchmark); after the battery, per-problem artifacts are committed under R401-WC2/BENCHMARK/RUNS/
